CHROMIUM: platform/x86: intel_pmc_core: Log the PMC wake source The patch adds support to log the source of wake from suspend-to-ram and suspend-to-idle states for Intel Sunrise Point PCH based platforms. This is intended to be used for diagnosing spurious wake ups during stability testing. Sample output from kernel dmesg below: [ 165.308571] intel_pmc_core 0000:00:1f.2: last_wake_source: RTC BUG=b:37219929 TEST=Put device in sleep state, then wake up using power button, RTC, USB keyboard etc. Read the wake source from debugfs. Remove leasing logic An oversight on my part. The lease obtaining should happen in job_reporter, but the abort socket should stay in lucifer_run_job. eve: Fix keyboard backlight pulsing with warm LED There are reports that dimly lid warm temperature LED light bulb can make Eve ALS readings to fluctuate between 0-24 lux. However as the cut-off for the ALS for turn off keyboard backlight is at 10 lux, this can make Eve keyboard backlight pulsing. This CL changes the cut off to 30 lux to avoid this. lakitu: workaround in kernel 4.12 ebuild to pick up config changes Lakitu maintains its own copy of kernel configuration. As a result for any change in Lakitu kernel configuration to be picked up by the CQ, we have to wait for a code change in the kernel source tree in order for the cros-workon ebuild to be uprevved. This patch works around the limitation similar to how the ChromiumOS kernel ebuild does for eclass changes. See src/third_party/chromiumos-overlay/sys-kernel/chromeos-kernel-4_4/chromeos-kernel-4_4-9999.ebuild for reference.
